behavior: check-spec-gate.sh exits 0 when production diff < threshold regardless of specs folder presence
verification: bats tests/check-spec-gate.bats -f 'exits 0 when diff is below threshold'

behavior: check-spec-gate.sh exits 0 when diff >= threshold AND active specs/<feature-id>/ folder is touched
verification: bats tests/check-spec-gate.bats -f 'exits 0 when diff >= threshold AND specs folder is touched'

behavior: check-spec-gate.sh exits 1 when diff >= threshold AND no specs folder is touched, with AGENTS.md reference in stderr
verification: bats tests/check-spec-gate.bats -f 'exits 1 when diff >= threshold AND no specs folder'

behavior: skip-sdd label + non-empty SDD skip rationale section bypasses the gate (logged in output)
verification: bats tests/check-spec-gate.bats -f 'exits 0 with skip-sdd label AND non-empty rationale'

behavior: skip-sdd label with empty rationale fails the gate
verification: bats tests/check-spec-gate.bats -f 'exits 1 when skip-sdd label present but rationale empty'

behavior: dependencies label (dependabot/renovate) bypasses the gate unconditionally
verification: bats tests/check-spec-gate.bats -f 'exits 0 when dependencies label present'

behavior: tests/, specs/archive/, *.lock, package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, go.sum, .gitignore, CHANGELOG.md, and *generated* paths are excluded from LOC count
specs/archive/ alone (no active spec) does not satisfy the gate
.github/workflows/spec-gate.yml runs the script on pull_request events
.github/pull_request_template.md exists with SDD checklist + skip-rationale section header
verification: grep -q 'SDD checklist' .github/pull_request_template.md && grep -q '## SDD skip rationale' .github/pull_request_template.md

behavior: install-precommit.sh --with-sdd-gate installs the pre-push hook type
verification: bats tests/install-precommit.bats -f 'includes pre-push hook-type when --with-sdd-gate set'

behavior: Full bats suite remains green after these changes (no regression)
